name: Arifuzzaman Raihan
headline: Co-Founder & CTO at NoteArch
tagline: Building AI products for education and disaster response
about: I build products that remove friction from education and digital business. As Co-Founder & CTO of NoteArch, I lead product and technology for an AI-powered Intelligent Academic Lifecycle Management System (IALMS), connecting schools, coaching centers, homeschools, teachers, parents, students and staff in one platform.
As Founder of Aicraftar and CodQube, I also build and ship digital products for education and marketplace use cases. Most recently I built RescueLens solo for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon.

Focus: product strategy for SaaS & EdTech platforms, AI-assisted workflows that save institutions time, clean UX, reliable systems and measurable outcomes. Open to strategic partnerships, founder collaborations and product conversations.

points: Lead product architecture, engineering direction and platform delivery
Build the seven-portal ecosystem: School Admin, Teacher/Tutor, Student, Parent, Staff, Contributor, TeknoBoard/TeknoBook
Lead product strategy and delivery for client and internal platforms
Partner with teams on SaaS, marketplace and digital transformation projects
Build and ship AI-powered products and digital platforms for education and business
Apply AI and data analysis to institutional workflows
Own technical architecture and Laravel-based platform delivery
Build reliable systems and mentor engineering execution
Designed and shipped generative AI workflows for production
Improved quality, latency and usefulness of AI-assisted experiences

projects.title: RescueLens
projects.description: AI disaster reporting and live alert platform built solo for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon (Indie Developer Track). Meta Muse Spark analyzes citizen photos and videos to classify incidents and severity, SAM 3.1 highlights the evidence, and verified alerts reach NGOs, help centers and responders on web and mobile.
